accepted.quote: When companies--especially in the P.R.C.--do not employ these practices, however, U.S. businesses of all sizes benefit tremendously from trade and collaboration.
accepted.rationale: Velazquez asserts that U.S. businesses broadly benefit from trade and collaboration with P.R.C. partners when unfair practices are absent.

accepted.quote: As part of its oversight duties, the Committee will closely monitor the implementation of this legislation, if enacted into law, to ensure that it is laser-focused on foreign conduct harming small businesses, and not on ethnicity or national origin.
accepted.rationale: Velazquez supports oversight to focus enforcement on foreign conduct that harms small businesses rather than ethnicity or national origin.
